name: FreeVideo
description: Generate videos and pictures locally with MiniMax H3 on a consumer NVIDIA GPU or Apple silicon Mac, and let Claude Code or Codex create, edit and export them through its MCP server.

skills.name: Generate Video
skills.description: Generates a video of up to 60 seconds from an H3 prompt, optionally from first or last frames or image, video and audio references.

skills.name: Generate Image
skills.description: Generates a picture from a prompt with MiniMax H3 Image, on its own or as a first frame, or changes and combines input pictures.

skills.name: Plan Job
skills.description: Validates a generation job without running it and returns frames, sampling passes, warnings and a time estimate for this computer.

skills.name: Assemble Clips
skills.description: Joins generated clips into one video, and imports your own footage into the editor to add subtitles and audio and export.
